contract.purpose: Build a 24-hour receiving appointment display for one day, dock and warehouse.
inputs_defaults: Captured declaration (literal placeholders are not executable values): CREATE PROCEDURE RPT_RecApptDaySchedule( @day datetime, @dock nvarchar(25), @warehouse nvarchar(25)) AS
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: @day is not normalized on parameter side: nonmidnight input causes no appointment matches while generating shifted hour rows. NULL dock/warehouse gives empty appointment side. NULL day still generates24NULL hour rows. Multiple appointments can multiply hour rows; same-hour start/end is one match, not two. Null trailer gives NULL scalar result.

ordered_branches.explanation: Generate 24 DATEADD hours starting at @day; receipt/appointment join filters truncated appointment start date=@day plus dock and receipt warehouse. Left join hour rows when hour-of-day equals START OR END hour, not every intervening hour. Trailer text subquery counts receipt headers sharing trailer_id across all warehouses/dates and adds resource text if count>1. Order hour,appointment start,receipt_id.
